body: Qwen3-VL is the multimodal large language model series developed by Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud.
plain_description: **Understand images, documents, and videos with a multimodal AI model.** Use it to recognize objects, extract text and key information, and reason about visual content. It can also help control computer and mobile interfaces.
technical_description: Qwen3-VL is a vision-language model series with Dense and MoE architectures, Instruct and Thinking editions, and model sizes ranging from 2B to 235B. The README shows local inference with Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang; online serving through an OpenAI-style API; and a browser-based demo. Capabilities include image and video understanding, OCR, document parsing, spatial reasoning, and visual agent tasks. The README also documents fine-tuning Qwen2-VL and Qwen2.5-VL.
title: Qwen3-VL
